description: Sinclairs Hotels Limited operates in the hospitality sector in India. The company operates a chain of hotels and resorts under Sinclairs brand name, including Sinclairs Burdwan, Sindlairs Siliguri, Sinclairs Darjeeling, Sinclairs Retreat Kalimpong, and Sinclairs Retreat Dooars in West Bengal; Sinclairs Gangtok in Sikkim. It also operates Sinclairs Palace Retreat Udaipur in Rajasthan; Sinclairs Retreat Ooty in Tamil Nadu; and Sinclairs Bayview Port Blair in Andamans. Sinclairs Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Kolkata, India.
